milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/observe oak_planks blocks. The oak_planks building front wall center is at spawn-relative (6, 2, 4). max_distance=5 ensures the player must physically approach the building wall rather than satisfying the milestone from spawn (~7.5 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the oak_planks wall.

Uses inventory_has because crafting dark_oak_slab (3 dark_oak_planks in a row → 6 dark_oak_slabs) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 6 dark_oak_planks and a crafting table is available inside the building. The 3-wide recipe requires the crafting table's 3x3 grid. The crafted slabs end up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting red_wool (1 white_wool + 1 red_dye → 1 red_wool, shapeless recipe) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 2 white_wool and 2 red_dye. The crafted red_wool ends up in inventory. This recipe can be done in either the 2x2 inventory grid or the crafting table.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the cyan_bed placed in the back of the building. The cyan bed head is at spawn-relative (8, 0, 10). max_distance=5 ensures the player must enter the building and approach the bed (it's ~4 blocks from the nearest interior wall), preventing false completion from outside through walls. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the bed.
